newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nordic Aluminium closed retail share offering.
newsitem.headline: Nordic Aluminium closed retail share offering.

text.p: Finnish aluminium components and profiles maker Nordic Aluminium said it closed its retail share offer on April 11 before the end of the subscription period.
"The retail offering was...closed...following strong demand," Nordic Aluminium said in a statement received late on Friday.
The retail share offering was initially scheduled to end on April 16.
The subscription period for institutional investors and employees was expected to close on or about April 17, it said.
"The shares are being offered to investors within an indicative price range of 45 to 53 markka per share," the company said.
The subscription price for institutional and retail investors would be fixed after the closing of the institutional offering, it said.
